done_when: The coordinator guide says: answer cold-read rounds yourself, and once a read is clean, grill the human one question at a time on the choices you made answering the notes (behaviours, limits, refusals, scope cuts) and record the answers in the plan before approval; new and existing repos get it through init and sync, and the guide test covers both
why: After cold reads pass, the coordinator brings the plan straight to approval, so the choices it made alone while answering the read notes never reach the human
